title: jsc2020m000074_VF_MS-13_Hatch_Closing_Undocking_Landing_Coverage_2020_0206
description: Expedition 61 Crew, Record-Setting Astronaut Christina Koch Return to Earth   Expedition 61 Commander Luca Parmitano of ESA (European Space Agency), Soyuz commander Alexander Skvortsov of Roscosmos and NASA Flight Engineer Christina Koch landed safely on Earth near the town of Dzhezkazgan, Kazakhstan, Feb. 6 after bidding farewell to their colleagues on the complex and undocking their Soyuz MS-13 spacecraft from the Poisk Module on the International Space Station. Koch completed a 328-day, 139-million mile mission on the orbital outpost --- the longest spaceflight ever conducted by a woman in history and the second longest single spaceflight by a U.S. astronaut. Parmitano and Skvortsov wrapped up a 201-day mission in space spanning 85.2 million miles.
keywords: Expedition 61, Landing, Christina Koch, Luca Parmitano, Alexander Skvortsov, Soyuz MS-13
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
